# WiseLake (와이즈레이크)

> WiseLake, Inc. is a Korean company that turns accumulated data into value for the AI era. It runs two lines of business: livestock AI for pig farms, and NanoTrans, which measures and trades the value of content that AI reads.

## Products

- [PigPlan AI Suite](https://wiselake.ai/pigplan): Korea's standard pig-farm management system (60.9% share of farm record systems, 700+ farms, since 1995) with three AIs: Insight (live, AI reports), Talk (AI you ask, opening January 2027) and Biz (management AI, opening January 2027). Korea only.
- [PigOS](https://pigos.io): AI early-warning farm OS for pig farms outside Korea. Records are judged against country-level KPI benchmarks the moment they are entered. Core is free; 7 languages; USA, China, Southeast Asia, Latin America.
- [NanoTrans](https://nanotrans.io): Index (measure AI citations), Edge (decide how each AI bot gets access), Market (trade content and data). In development, piloting with a Korean news publisher. Agent Paywall WordPress plugin is live.

## Company

- Name: WiseLake, Inc. (주식회사 와이즈레이크), founded January 28, 2022; PigPlan first built at a Seoul National University lab in 1995.
